_comment: Stands in for the Google Calendar events.list response when FIXTURE_DATA is set.
Shape mirrors the fields calendar.js destructures, so the real formatting,
multi-day handling and future/past partition all still run against it.
calendar.js splits on `new Date()` at build time, so fixture dates are parked
far either side of now — past events in 2019, future events in 2099 — and the
partition cannot flip as real time passes. That drift is what made the events
baseline unstable in the first place.
Between them these cover every branch the template renders: timed and all-day
events, a multi-day span (Google's all-day `end.date` is exclusive, so the
13th-17th entry must display as ending on the 16th), events with and without
a location, and enough past events to keep the faded `.is-past` styling under
